verdict.rationale: There is no documented retention or deletion feature. The only support comes from Hightouch's warehouse-native architecture: data stays in the customer's own warehouse or S3 bucket rather than in Hightouch (hightouch-docs-44, hightouch-comm-3, hightouch-docs-5), so retention is governed by the customer's own storage, and CDC syncs propagate removed rows to destinations (hightouch-docs-58). Missing for 10: explicit retention-period settings, a deletion/erasure API or workflow (e.g., GDPR/CCPA deletion requests), controls over Hightouch-side logs and metadata retention, a deletion endpoint in the MCP or REST API, and independent corroboration.
